name: Fisher's exact test
description: Fisher's exact test to evaluate the significance of associations between two categorical variables in a 2x2 contingency table

functions.name: compute_fisher_exact_test
functions.description: Run the Fisher's exact test and obtain results combined for all nodes

ui_visualizations.description: Odds ratio and p-value from Fisher's exact test
ui_visualizations.name: Fisher's exact test results

databases.name: Database
databases.description: Database containing the data to be included in the Fisher's exact test.

arguments.name: group_column
arguments.description: The column defining the two groups whose outcome distributions are compared.

arguments.name: outcome_column
arguments.description: The column containing the binary outcome variable used to compute event counts.

arguments.name: alternative
arguments.description: Alternative hypothesis ('two-sided', 'less', or 'greater') for 2×2 tables. Default: 'two-sided'.

arguments.name: organizations_to_include
arguments.description: The organizations to include in the task. If not given, all organizations in the collaboration are included.
